day_shape: 86 items: IRGC and Army claim cruise-missile and drone strikes on US bases in Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan; CENTCOM confirms new strikes on Iran and a naval blockade; Qatar/Pakistan push 10-day ceasefire proposal; France accuses Iran of assaulting embassy staff.

threads.label: Iranian claims of strikes on US bases
threads.summary: IRIB, Defa Press and IRGC public relations posts claimed drone and cruise-missile attacks on US facilities in Bahrain (including Amazon data infrastructure at Sheikh Isa base), Kuwait's Arifjan base, and Al-Rukban in Jordan. The Jerusalem Post reported Iran claimed to have struck US military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait with missile sirens sounding in both countries.

threads.label: US strikes and naval blockade on Iran
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced a new round of US strikes on Iran at 4pm ET aimed at degrading capabilities used against commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, and said it had redirected 7 commercial vessels and disabled 1 enforcing a naval blockade. The Jerusalem Post reported the US plans to send additional F-16, F-35 and refuelling aircraft to the region, with strikes near Bandar Abbas.

threads.label: Ceasefire mediation push
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported that Tehran initiated a proposed 10-day US-Iran ceasefire now being advanced by mediators, citing two sources familiar with negotiations. Iran International reported Qatar and Pakistan launched a joint effort to revive Iran-US diplomacy as exchanges entered a ninth day, with Tehran confirming receipt of new proposals.

threads.label: Shipping incidents in Gulf
threads.summary: IRIB relayed a UKMTO report of a vessel damaged by an unidentified projectile 17 nautical miles east of Dibba, UAE. The Jerusalem Post reported Greek shipping company Dynacom Tankers said two of its vessels were hit by projectiles in the US-facilitated southern Strait of Hormuz corridor, while Houthis declared a naval blockade against Saudi Arabia.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon safe-zone pilot launches
threads.summary: The IDF, CENTCOM and IDF Arabic spokesperson announced the launch of the 'Safe Zone' pilot programme in southern Lebanon in cooperation with the US military and Lebanese Armed Forces. The US State Department confirmed pilot zone operations began in Froun, Srifa and Zawtar Al-Gharbiya under the Trilateral Framework following last week's Rome discussions, with the Lebanese army deploying after Israeli withdrawal.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Hamas leadership
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing of Adham Ibrahim Sha'aban Nasman, Hamas's Gaza City Brigade operations head who directed the October 7 infiltration, in a Saturday strike, alongside two PIJ operatives including Taher Ahmad Salem Abd al-Wahed. The Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported Khalil al-Hayya has been elected Hamas's new political bureau chief.

threads.label: France embassy incident and Iran domestic
threads.summary: Iran International and the Jerusalem Post reported France accused Iranian security services of detaining two embassy staff for several hours and physically assaulting one, with Foreign Minister Barrot warning this 'cannot go without consequences'. Khamenei's office posted messages on hybrid warfare and threats against unnamed 'criminals', while Iran International reported exiled prince Reza Pahlavi called the US-led war a 'necessary step'.
